prompt_md: A car is behind one of three doors, goats behind the others. You pick one; the host, who knows, always opens another to show a goat. If you switch, what's your chance of winning?
prompt_short: Three doors, one car. Host shows a goat. Chance of winning if you switch?
hint_md: How often is your first pick wrong?
explain_intuition_md: Your first pick is wrong 2 times out of 3. Whenever it's wrong, the host has to leave the car behind the one door he didn't open, so switching wins. Switching only loses in the 1-in-3 case where you picked the car at the start.
